answer.text: Trial threshold scoring was added to Marketo lead scoring as part of an approved update to the scoring model documentation. This was decided in the Marketing Ops weekly meeting on May 8, 2026, by Rachel Kim with team consensus. The meeting record states: "we’re approving the new trial threshold scoring section, updating the main scoring model doc, and clarifying score decay." This decision was implemented in MR 19600 on May 21, 2026. The meeting record gives no further reason. [marketing/marketing-operations/marketo/_index#scoring-revamp-fy25q1]
